note: The six briefs of the walkthrough reported in the paper, two per discipline. Each entry holds the brief as it was entered on the hosted instance (the CaseInput that the create route accepts), the two team profiles used for the variants, and the case id on that instance. briefSource records how the brief was written. `pnpm walkthrough-report --briefs demo/walkthrough/briefs.json --csv-out demo/walkthrough/case-study.csv` reads the six cases from the database and rewrites case-study.csv.

targetLearnerProfile.priorKnowledge: Time value of money and basic financial statements; has not appraised a project before
